results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:3-6: 'user-added or changed ones ride along from src'
results.story: The owner changed the factory password; the new build re-salted the factory hash. update-profile must keep the owner's password, not hand back the factory one.
expected: 'root' is exactly: root:*:20350:0:99999:7::: (untouched entry follows the new base)
a 'root' entry exists and no key appears twice

results.title: Empty base file keeps the other files in their roles
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:2 (positional roles); migrate-profile:401 passes an empty file when the base lacks the database. Found and fixed by rafaetri in flipperos-btrfs-tools #4, merged as 438ada7
results.story: With an empty base, an account identical in the new base and the profile must survive. If awk counts files by their first line, an empty file shifts every role.
expected: a 'root' entry exists and no key appears twice

results.title: Account the owner deleted is not revived by a rebuilt base
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:3-6: 'user-deleted ones stay deleted' (libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:25-26, added in 8c9ffc7)
results.story: The owner deleted the factory 'user' account. Every build re-salts the factory hash, so the new base's record always differs from the old base's. Before 8c9ffc7 the merge therefore brought the factory shadow record back (reported on #140); since 8c9ffc7 a deletion in the profile wins.
expected: a 'root' entry exists and no key appears twice

results.title: Owner password survives when the base lacks the database
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:3-6: changed ones ride along from src; with no base record the profile's record wins (libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:29-30, since 8c9ffc7)
results.story: With no base record the merge cannot tell who changed what. With #4 alone, the new base won and a factory credential replaced the owner's. Upstream confirmed this is not reachable on a device (migrate-profile needs the _stock, and every stock carries all eight account files), and since 8c9ffc7 the profile's record wins on that path anyway.

results.title: Group password the owner set survives an unchanged base
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:3-6: changed ones ride along from src; mergerec applies the same 3-way rule to scalar group/gshadow fields (libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:37-38, since 8c9ffc7)
results.story: The owner set a group password on 'wheel' in gshadow; the new build did not touch that field. Before 8c9ffc7 every non-list group field came from the new base, so the owner's change was dropped (reported on #140); since 8c9ffc7 it survives.

limitations: Only libs/flipper-accountdb.awk is executed. migrate-profile's surrounding steps (btrfs send, finalize_accountdbs, check_db_pair, rsync) are not run.
Inputs are synthetic account databases with placeholder hashes, not files from a device.
No result here was obtained on Flipper One or RK3576 hardware.
Passing every scenario does not make a revision secure; it means these scenarios hold.
